text: According to the Calder Vane Foundation’s announcement posted Thursday and confirmed by the prize jury chair, architect Tomasz Okonjo has won this year’s Calder Vane Prize for architecture. The foundation said the award recognizes Okonjo’s Meridia Civic Library in Port Lask, a 2024 commission that, in the jury’s words, “recast a municipal building as a public landscape.” Jury chair Helena Voss said the €250,000 prize was decided unanimously after site visits in May and June. Okonjo, who is based in Braden, said in a statement that the honor “belongs to the librarians, engineers and residents who shaped the project from the first sketch.” The prize ceremony is scheduled for 18 November in Lyrham.
